maddeler.e: مِنَ النَّهْرِ إلَى الْبَحْرِ • (mina n-nahri ʔilā l-baḥri)
maddeler.t: Literally, “from the [Jordan] river to the [Mediterranean] sea”, referring to the claim over all of pre-1948 territory of Palestine.
s: Literally, “from the [Jordan] river to the [Mediterranean] sea”
g: A phrase expressing support for a Palestinian one-state solution.
ds: from the river to the sea
desde el río hasta el mar
